propositions: Every CI job makes an avoidable network call to raw.githubusercontent.com before starting because uv is unpinned; when that call fails the job fails with ##[error]fetch failed

astral-sh/setup-uv is pinned to SHA ae62891fec2bb8e7d6c99fc78c9fec3a63790f8d but the uv version itself is not pinned (no version input, no [tool.uv] required-version, no uv.toml), causing setup-uv to fall back to LatestVersionResolver and fetch a remote manifest

Adding [tool.uv] required-version = "==0.12.7" to the root pyproject.toml pins uv exactly at all 25 call sites without modifying any workflow file, removing the version-determination fallback log and suppressing the remote manifest fetch during version resolution
scripts/check_uv_pin.py guard asserts the pin exists, is exact (==X.Y.Z not a range), and no workflow carries version/version-file input, preventing accidental divergence between jobs
The resolved uv can currently change between runs or between publishes with no repository change due to the unpinned version, a supply-chain risk that the pin eliminates
